verdict.rationale: Sardine markets 'audit-ready agents' for automated KYC/AML alert reviews and a case management workspace for resolving cases, which points toward auditability of automated decisions. Nothing documents a retrievable, timestamped log covering both human and automated decisions. missing for 10: documented timestamped audit log, coverage of human analyst decisions, retrieval/export method (API or report), field-level detail, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can retrieve a timestamped audit trail of human and automated case decisions

citations.quote: Automate KYC/AML alert reviews and speed up investigations with audit-ready agents.
Unified workspace to review alerts, conduct investigations, and resolve cases.
